description: This file defines a React component for the dashboard page of a documentation quality dashboard frontend. It manages state related to projects, metrics, suggestions, and UI loading states, fetching data from API endpoints, and rendering various UI components including header, footer, metrics overview, problems list, and filters.

methods.name: initialFilters
methods.description: Initializes the filters state with default values.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Asynchronously loads metrics and suggestions for a selected project, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: handleDocTypeChange
methods.description: Updates the filters state when the document type filter is changed.

methods.name: handleSelectProject
methods.description: Handles project selection, updates project ID, and reloads data.
